lines.text: Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, and Martha served at a dinner for Him.
Mary anointed Jesus' hands with about a pint of pure nard perfume and wiped them with her hair.
Judas Iscariot asked why the perfume wasn't sold and the money given to the poor, though he was a thief.
Jesus told Judas to leave her alone, saying she had kept the perfume for the day of His wedding.
A large crowd came to see Lazarus too, so the chief priests planned to kill him.
